liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Shakedown Street** (1 review): Brent's solo in Shakedown Street is described as pretty much sonic and impressive [20]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Terrapin Station is described as being in prime pre-studio form [23]
- **Saint Of Circumstance** (1 review): Complete pause before the beginning of Saint of Circumstance is highlighted as a must [14]
- **Black Peter** (1 review): The rendition of Black Peter is singled out as a smoking performance [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1979-12-11.mtx.haugh-miller.92439.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 24 songs; 171 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd79-12-11.sbd.barbella.5981.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 24 songs; 175 min; rated 2.67/5 by 3 [5]. Said about its sound: Listener notes audible hiss from the cassette tape on this soundboard recording; Jerry's guitar is hard to hear, but Brent sounds badass and others perform well [13][16]
- **gd1979-12-11.sonyECM250.walker-scotton.miller.89166.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 23 songs; 173 min; rated 2.67/5 by 3 [6]
- **gd79-12-11.sbd.miller.28890.sbeok.flacf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 175 min; rated 3.5/5 by 10 [9]. Said about its sound: Jerry has a hard time vocally but uses a good dose of the Mutron III; Phil dominates on bass and there is prolific percussion throughout the recording [20]
- **gd79-12-11.naks.chase.9799.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 162 min; rated 4/5 by 4 [11]. Said about its sound: Audience recording praised for thick, mellow, alive, and jazzy energy and quality [14]

## Around the show

- Show was played on local community radio during the weekly Dead Head's show [18]
- Brent, new to the stage, offered spirited keyboard work and accompanying vocals on this song [18]
- The band performed at Soldiers' and Sailors' Memorial Hall in Kansas City, KS on this date [26]
- China Cat Sunflower into I Know You Rider is compared to the Stanley Theater '79 standard [23]
- This show is considered a great performance, highlighting Brent's vintage playing style [24]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1979-12-11.mtx.haugh-miller.92439.flac16**: taped by See Notes; transferred by Dan Haugh and Charlie Miller; source: See Notes [1]. Also: SBD to Nak 550 cassette, then Sony D5, Nakamichi DR-1, and Sound Devices 744T; FOB Sony ECM-250 to Sony TC-158/TDK SA-C90 cassette master, then Nakamichi DR-1 [1]
- **gd79-12-11.sbd.barbella.5981.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [5]
- **gd1979-12-11.sonyECM250.walker-scotton.miller.89166.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Joani Walker; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Sony ECM-250 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-158/TDK SA-C90) [6]. Also: Nakamichi 700 to cassette master, reel, Dat, and CD, based on tapes by Scotton and Walker [6]
- **gd79-12-11.sbd.miller.28890.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard [9]
- **gd79-12-11.naks.chase.9799.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Unknown; source: Audience Recording [11]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Ed Perlstein: [31 Days of Dead 2020 | Day #5: “Lost Sailor > Saint of Circumstance > Jam” – Kansas City, KS 12/11/79](https://linernotesmusicblog.wordpress.com/2020/12/05/31-days-of-dead-2020-day-5-lost-sailor-saint-of-circumstance-jam-kansas-city-ks-12-11-79/) [31]
- Poster by Marsia Tunis Grateful Dead: [1979-12-11 Soldiers' and Sailors' Memorial Hall, Kansas City, KS, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1979-12-11-soldiers-and-sailors-memorial-hall-kansas-city-ks-usa/) [32]
